review_notes: I read the whole file and the definitions of ProductIncrement, productMass, productLeft and productRight in Replicas/VectorBranch.lean. The only repeated machinery is productLeft_map and productRight_map. Their proofs are the same short induction with the same simp set and a single `rw [ih]`. The reasoning is routine unfolding of filterMap on the two Sum constructors. A shared filterMap-commutation lemma would only save about two lines per use. It would also have to be stated for general selector functions and then specialised, which would cost more than it saves. This falls under the rubric's exclusions for short or routine proofs. mergedProductBranches_map is a single use of List.map_merge, so nothing in it repeats. Productmass_map is a one-line `cases p <;> rfl`. I did not check other files that might repeat these lemmas, because the rubric concerns repetition inside proofs. I am not certain whether other files in the project repeat this induction pattern.
